rationale: All four original blocking findings are now fully resolved. CR-001: useController called at component level, nested Controller removed. CR-002: double-cast replaced with .map() projection. CR-003: useEditPopupForm.test.ts created with 4 behavioral tests covering create/edit timezone defaults. CR-004 (round 1 unresolved): timezone added to CreateSharePointIndexOptions interface and as trailing optional param + body field to createKBIndexJIRA, createKBIndexXray, createKBIndexAzureDevOpsWiki, createKBIndexAzureDevOpsWorkItem, createKBIndexGoogleDoc; request.timezone threaded through all six call sites in useCreateIndex.ts including the createKBIndexSharePoint object literal. The fix-up diff introduces no new high-risk issues; vite.config.ts proxy and .codemie config changes are developer-local preferences.

finding_status.notes: Resolved in round 1. useController hook called at DataSourceForm component level; nested <Controller name='timezone'> removed; timezoneField.value/onChange passed directly to CronScheduleInput props.
Resolved in round 1. .map(({ label, value }) => ({ label, value: value as string })) replaces double-cast; TypeScript structural check now enforced.

Resolved in round 1. useEditPopupForm.test.ts created with 4 behavioral tests: create defaults to getBrowserTimezone(); edit uses defaults.timezone when present; edit falls back to getBrowserTimezone() when defaults.timezone is undefined; falls back when null. id: '1' in edit fixtures correctly triggers the useEffect guard.

Resolved in round 2. dataSources.ts: timezone?: string added to CreateSharePointIndexOptions interface and as trailing optional param + body field to createKBIndexJIRA, createKBIndexXray, createKBIndexAzureDevOpsWiki, createKBIndexAzureDevOpsWorkItem, and createKBIndexGoogleDoc. useCreateIndex.ts: request.timezone added as trailing positional arg to all five call sites; timezone: request.timezone added to the createKBIndexSharePoint object literal. All six previously-broken CREATE paths now transmit timezone to the API payload.
